The most recent polling data from The Economist and YouGov, taken August 21-28 found that 36 percent of Hispanic voters approved of how Trump is handling his job.

It is a 13-point increase from May 22-26, when 23 percent approved of the president’s job performance, according to polling. It is a further 5-point increase from polling data recorded July 25-27, when 31 percent of Hispanic voters approved of the president. The number was slightly higher, 34 percent, in poll data taken June 26-29. [...] Breaking News

results.content:
Two out of three voters in Valadao’s district are Hispanic, and AP-NORC polling shows that Trump’s national approval rating among Hispanic adults fell by 18 percentage points between March 2025 and July 2026. By comparison, approval among U.S. adults overall dropped 9 points.

Valadao said he isn’t panicking.

“I’ve won in these types of races. I can win again,” he said in an interview with The Associated Press. “I think we should be fine.”
